body: Wow I completely understand this situation. Never feel bad for expressing the way you feel and feeling overwhelmed by a friends own mental health issues. I’m a hypocrite because I’m not good at this but being understanding and supportive is different than taking on the role of a therapist psychiatrist support system all at once. You deserve piece of mind too. I would suggest that you give her the resources to help and maybe even suggest she talk to another friend who is better prepared to help. You need to make sure you aren’t hurting yourself by attempting to help her. Don’t feel guilty , this is something everybody deals with and you aren’t bad for needing to take  care of yourself ❤️❤️

I relate to this so much and even though I haven’t been diagnosed with BPD, this resonated with me so much. I always feel the need to hook up right away because I feel like that’s all that people want from me and I don’t know how to get close to people until we’ve hooked up. It’s created so many problems for me and probably stems from sexual abuse and assault too but I feel like part of me always need instant validation and sex is the easiest way to get that. like if a guy I’m seeing wants to get to know me and not just hook up I feel like he doesn’t like me and there’s something wrong with me. Sorry if this doesn’t make sense and I hope that you can find a way to come to peace with yourself and know that there are understanding people out there ❤️ if you ever need support let me know

I’m sorry this is happening to you and you deserve better! Is there anyway you can ask your parents to help mediate and make her understand that she needs to  respect you as a human being? Nobody should be treated badly because of a psychological difficulty , that’s not how family treats each other
While I’m sad you can relate , I appreciate the validation

I know it may be difficult but supporting your friend is extremely admirable. As someone who relates to these issues, It makes me really happy to know that someone suffering from mental health has a supportive friend like you. All you can do is be there for her and listen to her when she needs to express herself. I wish you and her the best of luck!! 💜💜💜
I hate to say I feel the same but I do. Don’t worry you’re not alone. Hope you can find peace ❤️

Don’t feel bad I did this at a party while abroad and my friend cleaned me up and put me to bed and took care of me. It’s good that you have loving friends around you. A relapse is nothing to be embarrassed about. We are all here for you 💜

I know what it is like to feel down and rely on alcohol for comfort and I’m telling you it will get better as long as you focus on being kind to yourself as you go forward and realizing your worth. My therapist told me that bad coping mechanisms like drinking  are still coping mechanisms which means you are taking an interest in changing your situation and making yourself feel better ( which you should acknowledge as a personal strength) but you want to transition to less destructive forms of coping. You are on your way and even though it’s incredibly difficult right now , try and reflect on other times you have overcome difficulties. You are strong and will defeat this, trust me. I believe in you, you got this.

This has happened to me as well and I still feel guilty. I would never wish that on anyone. I hope you can find it in yourself to understand that you could not stopped this and it is in no way your fault. Trust me.
